subject: NSKeyedArchiver.archivedDataWithRootObject:

observation.summary: Runtime probe iterates class_copyMethodList() on NSKeyedArchiver and NSKeyedUnarchiver. NSKeyedArchiver exposes the canonical archiving entry points as class methods: +archivedDataWithRootObject:, +archivedDataWithRootObject:requiringSecureCoding:error:. NSKeyedUnarchiver exposes the matching +unarchiveObjectWithData: and +unarchiveObjectWithData:error:. Both classes inherit from NSCoder. NSCoder's protocol surface (-encodeWithCoder: / -initWithCoder:) is observed as instance methods on every concrete Foundation class (NSString, NSArray, NSDictionary, NSNumber, NSValue, NSDate, NSURL, NSError, NSUUID).

claim: NSKeyedArchiver is a NSCoder subclass that exports +archivedDataWithRootObject: (+ the secure-coding variant) as its public class-method entry point, and NSKeyedUnarchiver exports +unarchiveObjectWithData: (+ the throwing variant) — these are the NSCoder / NSKeyedArchiver archive bridge symbols.
